objective: Definir el contrato puro de disparadores operativos de Cavas para reutilizar la infraestructura existente de tareas/notificaciones de EDARSAHUB. No crear tablas nuevas, no duplicar motor de tareas, no implementar proveedor de email/WhatsApp. El dominio debe expresar ALERTA -> TAREA -> RESPONSABLE -> FECHA LIMITE -> SEGUIMIENTO -> RESULTADO y producir referencias opacas para workflow_id/task_id/notification_id existentes.

class CavaOperationalTrigger(str, Enum):
    RENOVACION_PROXIMA = "RENOVACION_PROXIMA"
    RENOVACION_VENCIDA = "RENOVACION_VENCIDA"
    PAGO_PENDIENTE = "PAGO_PENDIENTE"
    DOCUMENTO_FALTANTE = "DOCUMENTO_FALTANTE"
    INVENTARIO_PENDIENTE_CERTIFICAR = "INVENTARIO_PENDIENTE_CERTIFICAR"
    BOTELLA_PENDIENTE_DISPOSICION = "BOTELLA_PENDIENTE_DISPOSICION"
    CIERRE_ASIGNACION_BLOQUEADO = "CIERRE_ASIGNACION_BLOQUEADO"
    CONFIRMACION_MOVIMIENTO_PENDIENTE = "CONFIRMACION_MOVIMIENTO_PENDIENTE"
    DISPUTA_MOVIMIENTO_ABIERTA = "DISPUTA_MOVIMIENTO_ABIERTA"


class OperationalWorkStatus(str, Enum):
    PENDIENTE = "PENDIENTE"
    EN_SEGUIMIENTO = "EN_SEGUIMIENTO"
    COMPLETADA = "COMPLETADA"
    CANCELADA = "CANCELADA"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CavaOperationalWorkIntent:
    trigger: CavaOperationalTrigger
    subject_type: str
    subject_id: str
    responsible_id: str
    due_at: str
    reason: str
    workflow_id: Optional[str] = None
    task_id: Optional[str] = None
    notification_id: Optional[str] = None
    status: OperationalWorkStatus = OperationalWorkStatus.PENDIENTE
    result: Optional[str] = None


def validate_operational_work_intent(intent: CavaOperationalWorkIntent) -> None:
    required = {
        "subject_type": intent.subject_type,
        "subject_id": intent.subject_id,
        "responsible_id": intent.responsible_id,
        "due_at": intent.due_at,
        "reason": intent.reason,
    }
    for field_name, value in required.items():
        if not str(value or "").strip():
            raise ValueError(f"CavaOperationalWorkIntent requiere {field_name}")
    if intent.status == OperationalWorkStatus.COMPLETADA and not str(intent.result or "").strip():
        raise ValueError("Una tarea completada requiere resultado")


def can_close_operational_work(intent: CavaOperationalWorkIntent) -> bool:
    validate_operational_work_intent(intent)
    return intent.status in {OperationalWorkStatus.COMPLETADA, OperationalWorkStatus.CANCELADA}


def provider_delivery_failure_blocks_business_event() -> bool:
    return False

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    CavaOperationalTrigger,
    CavaOperationalWorkIntent,
    OperationalWorkStatus,
    can_close_operational_work,
    provider_delivery_failure_blocks_business_event,
    validate_operational_work_intent,
)


def _intent(**overrides):
    data = dict(
        trigger=CavaOperationalTrigger.RENOVACION_PROXIMA,
        subject_type="CONTRACT_PERIOD",
        subject_id="PER-1",
        responsible_id="USR-1",
        due_at="2026-10-01T12:00:00Z",
        reason="Renovacion proxima",
    )
    data.update(overrides)
    return CavaOperationalWorkIntent(**data)


def test_operational_work_requires_responsible_due_date_and_reason():
    validate_operational_work_intent(_intent())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_operational_work_intent(_intent(responsible_id=""))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_operational_work_intent(_intent(due_at=""))


def test_completion_requires_result():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_operational_work_intent(_intent(status=OperationalWorkStatus.COMPLETADA))
    completed = _intent(status=OperationalWorkStatus.COMPLETADA, result="Renovacion gestionada")
    assert can_close_operational_work(completed) is True


def test_pending_work_cannot_be_considered_closed():
    assert can_close_operational_work(_intent()) is False


def test_existing_operational_ids_are_references_not_new_task_engine():
    intent = _intent(workflow_id="WF-1", task_id="TASK-1", notification_id="NOTIF-1")
    validate_operational_work_intent(intent)
    assert intent.task_id == "TASK-1"


def test_notification_provider_failure_does_not_rollback_canonical_business_event():
    assert provider_delivery_failure_blocks_business_event() is False


def test_contract_covers_core_cavas_operational_triggers():
    assert {
        CavaOperationalTrigger.RENOVACION_PROXIMA,
        CavaOperationalTrigger.PAGO_PENDIENTE,
        CavaOperationalTrigger.DOCUMENTO_FALTANTE,
        CavaOperationalTrigger.INVENTARIO_PENDIENTE_CERTIFICAR,
        CavaOperationalTrigger.CIERRE_ASIGNACION_BLOQUEADO,
        CavaOperationalTrigger.DISPUTA_MOVIMIENTO_ABIERTA,
    }.issubset(set(CavaOperationalTrigger))

constraints: NO nuevas tablas CavaSocios_Tareas o CavaSocios_Notificaciones
Reutilizar capacidades operativas existentes de EDARSAHUB para persistencia/entrega
No hardcodear responsables, canales, horarios ni SLA
